body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success against Harmony, it suffers -1 Defense until the start of its next turn.

surges.html: Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1.
Increase one range, radius, or numeric Echo effect by 1.

rider.title: HEX RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The hexed creature fails an Action or Reaction. Echo: It burns 1 die on its next Action.
